title: create-coralite v1.3.0
summary: The 1.3.0 release adds Codeberg release tooling to the Coralite CLI. Static components can now compile to zero client JavaScript without dummy exports.
html:
The Coralite CLI now creates Codeberg releases with versioned release archives. It integrates tabbyAPI for release-related workflows. create-coralite v1.3.0 packages these CLI changes for new projects.

Static components can omit tags instead of triggering a Script tag must contain text error.

Adds unit tests for empty, comment-only, and helper-only scripts in development and production. Updates AGENTS.md, template instructions, and documentation to clarify that static components require neither script blocks nor placeholder exports.

title: coralite v1.2.0
summary: Coralite v1.2.0 establishes compile-time boolean and ARIA attribute reflection for static HTML pages, ensuring pre-rendered templates omit falsy attributes and serialize valid ARIA states without runtime JavaScript overhead. This release also introduces semantic page composition and component reuse standards to agent scaffolding, while consolidating runtime globals under a unified namespace.
html:
Pages now share identical attribute reflection semantics with components during static HTML rendering and dynamic client-side hydration. Single-token bindings ({{ prop }}) evaluate against HTML boolean specifications, ARIA state definitions, and custom element schemas rather than performing raw string interpolation. Pre-rendered HTML omits falsy boolean attributes entirely, eliminating invalid DOM states such as disabled="false" that native browsers interpret as active.

  • Shared Reflection Engine: lib/shared/tags.js exports resolveBooleanOrAriaAttribute(), applyAstBoundAttribute() for build-time AST manipulation, and applyDomBoundAttribute() for client DOM updates.
  • Static SSR Resolution: lib/server/renderer.js evaluates single-token attribute bindings against custom element schemas and strips falsy boolean attributes (false, null, undefined, 0, '') directly from the static AST output.
  • ARIA Normalization: ARIA boolean states (aria-expanded, aria-hidden, aria-checked, aria-pressed) normalize truthy values to "true", falsy values to "false", and remove attributes when values resolve to null or undefined.
  • Direct Client Updates: lib/client/page-runtime.js replaces full-tree DOM crawling (updateLegacyPageTokens) with targeted DOM mutations, reducing hydration time and reactive flush overhead.

Page Definition (src/pages/dashboard.html)

<button disabled="{{ isDisabled }}" aria-expanded="{{ isExpanded }}" aria-label="{{ label }}"> Toggle Panel </button> <ui-modal open="{{ isModalOpen }}"></ui-modal> <script type="module"> export const meta = { isDisabled: false, isExpanded: false, label: null, isModalOpen: false } export function client({ state }) { // Dynamic mutations reflect directly to DOM attributes: // state.isDisabled = true -> renders disabled="" // state.isDisabled = false -> removes disabled attribute } </script>

html:
Starter templates now scaffold new projects against coralite ^1.2.0 by default. Newly initialized applications receive compile-time boolean and ARIA attribute reflection on static pages, removing falsy attributes from pre-rendered HTML without emitting client-side JavaScript.

  • Updated Dependencies: packages/create-coralite/templates/css/package.json, packages/create-coralite/templates/scss/package.json, and packages/create-coralite/templates/plugin/package.json upgrade the coralite development dependency from ^1.1.0 to ^1.2.0.
  • Compile-Time Static Attribute Reflection: New projects evaluate single-token attribute bindings ({{ prop }}) against HTML boolean and ARIA specifications during SSR, omitting falsy boolean attributes directly from the pre-rendered AST.
  • Deterministic Hydration: Client runtimes perform direct DOM updates rather than full-tree token crawling, preserving zero-JS static baselines and reducing hydration overhead.

Template Dependency (package.json)

"devDependencies": { - "coralite": "^1.1.0" + "coralite": "^1.2.0" }

Scaffolded Page Static Output (src/pages/index.html)

<button disabled="{{ isDisabled }}" aria-expanded="{{ isExpanded }}"> Action </button> <script type="module"> export const meta = { isDisabled: false, isExpanded: false } </script> <!-- Compiled Static HTML Output (zero client JS): --> <!-- <button aria-expanded="false">Action</button> -->

Template AI agent instructions across the agent, css, plugin, and scss starter directories now align with the single window.coralite runtime global namespace invariant. Scaffolding documentation updates imperative SPA router lookups from the legacy global to the structured plugin domain.

  • Consolidated Router Lookup: Agent guidelines in packages/create-coralite/templates/agent/AGENTS.md, packages/create-coralite/templates/css/AGENTS.md, packages/create-coralite/templates/plugin/AGENTS.md, and packages/create-coralite/templates/scss/AGENTS.md replace window._coraliterouter with window.coralite__.plugins.router.
  • Global Pollution Prevention: Prohibits ad-hoc property attachments on window and globalThis in generated code, ensuring scaffolded projects maintain clean browser globals and deterministic testing sandboxes.

Imperative SPA Router Access

title: coralite v1.0.0-rc.6
html:
• Signals: Replaced Proxy-based reactivity with a signal-based primitive for faster, more predictable updates.
  • Global Store: Added store configuration and context key for application-wide reactive state.

  • Router Plugin: Added the opt-in SPA router with beforeEach guards and View Transitions support.
  • CLI: coralite now owns all build, dev, and test scripts. coralite-scripts is deprecated.
  • Type-Checking: Added Volar-bridged type checking to coralite check --types.
  • Async Getters: Added support for async getters with sync-prologue dependency tracking.
  • Context Protocol: Updated provide/consume to support string keys with fallback.
  • Auto-registration: Core plugins (lists, router) are now included automatically.
  • coralite-scripts is deprecated. Use coralite dev, coralite build, etc.
  • urlStyle config replaced by cleanUrls: boolean.
  • templates config replaced by components.
  • Pages using bare exports (export const paths) must migrate to definePage.
  • style signature is now ({ state }) => ....
  • slots signature is now ({ nodes, state }) => ....
